 Jailer 2 OTT Version May Feature an Extended Cut 
Mumbai | 5 Nov, 2026 | 11:29 PM IST | By DPIFF Editorial Desk | Share 
 Share this link via
 Jailer 2 OTT Version May Feature an Extended Cut
 Jailer 2 could receive a more expansive OTT presentation, with a report shared by Dadasaheb Phalke International Film Festival suggesting that the streaming version may include approximately 30 minutes of additional footage. The reported material could feature deleted or previously unseen sequences involving Mohanlal and Vijay Sethupathi .
 The possibility is significant for audiences awaiting the next chapter of the franchise led by Rajinikanth . However, the extended cut has not been established as an officially confirmed release detail in the information currently available. No streaming platform or OTT premiere date has been announced in the referenced post.
 What the reported Jailer 2 extended cut could include
 According to the DPIFF Instagram post , the proposed OTT version could add around half an hour to the theatrical edit. The additional footage is reportedly connected to scenes involving Mohanlal and Vijay Sethupathi, two performers whose presence has contributed to the anticipation surrounding the film.
 It is important to distinguish between a reported possibility and a confirmed production announcement. The available information does not establish whether the footage has been finalised, whether it was removed from the theatrical version during editing, or whether the eventual streaming release will carry a different runtime. Those details would need to come from the filmmakers, production house or streaming partner.
 Why an extended streaming version matters
 Streaming releases often give filmmakers more flexibility than theatrical versions. A cinema release must work within programming schedules, audience expectations and the commercial demands of multiple markets. An OTT edition can sometimes accommodate longer character beats, additional action material or scenes that were shortened for the theatrical cut.
 For a large-scale franchise film, extra footage can also change how viewers understand its supporting characters and relationships. If the reported scenes involving Mohanlal and Vijay Sethupathi are included, audiences may gain more context about their roles and their connection to the wider world of Jailer 2 . At present, the nature of those scenes remains unconfirmed, so it would be premature to draw conclusions about their importance to the story.
 Rajinikanth, Nelson and the Jailer franchise
 The development follows the success and visibility of Jailer , the Rajinikanth-led action film directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Sun Pictures. The original film established a distinctive blend of star-driven action, dark humour and ensemble appearances, creating strong interest in any continuation of its universe.
 Information about the franchise should be followed through reliable sources, including the official Sun Pictures website and announcements from the filmmakers. Basic film information about the original Jailer is also available through its IMDb listing , although third-party databases should not be treated as substitutes for official release announcements.
 The reported OTT cut also reflects a wider change in the way major Indian films are consumed. Viewers increasingly expect streaming editions to offer more than a second window for the theatrical version. When additional material is officially released, it can extend a film’s conversation beyond cinemas and encourage audiences to revisit its performances, editing choices and narrative structure.
 What has been confirmed so far
 The DPIFF post refers to a possible OTT version of Jailer 2 with approximately 30 minutes of additional footage.
 The reported footage may include deleted scenes involving Mohanlal and Vijay Sethupathi.
 The post does not confirm an OTT platform, streaming date, final runtime or whether the extended cut has been approved for release.
 Until an official announcement is issued, the reported extended version should be viewed as an unconfirmed possibility rather than a fixed feature of the release. Any final information about the cut, platform and availability will carry greater authority when communicated by the production team or official streaming partner.
 DPIFF Instagram Reference
 The possibility of additional footage in the Jailer 2 OTT version was highlighted in the original DPIFF Instagram post .
